title: R&M Mardi Gras Cookie Cutter Gift Mask
amazon_match_notes: Exact match by ASIN B0058IUU2W to R&M model 5183, UPC 768545051832: 3-piece Mardi Gras set with a 3.5in mask, 4in fleur de lis and 3.5in music note.

comparisons.notes: Product page image file is 5183.png (MPN 5183); listing matches exactly: Mardi Gras 3 PC set with Mask 3.5in, Fleur De Lis 4in, Music Note 3.5in, steel, 11.5x4.25x1.18in. Priced and no out-of-stock notice shown.

writeup: Woot has R&M's Mardi Gras 3-piece cookie cutter set (model 5183, UPC 768545051832) for $3.99. The set includes a 3.5-inch mask, a 4-inch fleur de lis, and a 3.5-inch music note, with 1-inch-deep steel sides. R&M International's own site lists the matching Mardi Gras 3 PC set at $9.99 and shows it in stock. That is 60 percent below the verified store price and saves about $6. Woot showed 10+ left with a limit of ten per customer.
